tasks.instruction: MUSE-74: independent bounded audit of new E3-to-S3 transfer intervals. Read MUSE.md, docs/engineering/PORTAL_TRANSFER_PRECISION.md and only the referenced modules/tests. Add a seeded Node regression comparing e3S3TransferBounds with the existing compiled portal transit for simultaneous bounded direction/point perturbations and a few rotated/translated frames; include center, rim and nearly parallel cases. Use actual perturbed direction values inside declared component error boxes; do not normalize them outside those boxes without checking inclusion. Report which assumptions are tested and which are not. Do not claim existing GPU enclosure: no browser/queue/shader runs. Test interval containment, not nominal closeness. Include a meaningful isolated fail-demo (copy/mutation only; never change engine in your delivered tree). Run focused test and full Node suite once; report failures without repair. Allowed writes only portal-transfer-truth.test.js and docs/qa/muse74-transfer-bounds.md. No kernel/app/schema/other docs changes, no commits/pushes, no agents. Keep report under500 words. If a real counterexample appears, minimize and pin it, stop expanding the corpus; do not loosen the claim or fix production code.
